description: Reliability validation and production integration - validate prediction reliability buckets, integrate proven improvements, and ensure production system integrity
steps: Create backend/app/prediction/reliability_buckets.py to analyze calibration buckets (50-55%, 55-60%, etc.) with adequate historical observations
Create backend/scripts/evaluate_reliability_buckets.py to test whether predicted X% events actually happen ~X% of the time
Create backend/app/prediction/data_quality_agreement.py to analyze data quality score interactions (if sufficient data available)
Integrate only validated improvements into backend/app/prediction/service.py with production endpoint testing
Run comprehensive regression testing and update docs/PROGRESS.md with Phase 10.3 results
acceptance_criteria: Reliability bucket analysis creates probability buckets only with adequate historical observations and reports empirical findings
Bucket evaluation tests actual calibration: does predicted 70% event happen ~70% of time, based on real historical data
Data quality analysis evaluates available database fields or reports INSUFFICIENT_HISTORICAL_SAMPLE if mostly null
Production integration includes only changes with demonstrated OOS improvement, maintaining Phase 10.1/10.2 functionality
Regression testing shows all existing prediction/model/walk-forward tests pass with no new failures from Phase 10.3 changes
verification: python backend/scripts/evaluate_reliability_buckets.py produces bucket analysis showing actual vs predicted probability comparison
GET /api/v1/matches/fotmob_5071211/prediction returns HTTP 200 with is_development_data=false after any production integration
python -m pytest tests/prediction/ shows all existing tests pass plus new Phase 10.3 tests
docs/PROGRESS.md contains complete Phase 10.3 documentation with actual results achieved for each GROUP
